request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Reedmask Stalker".

Creative brief
Name: Reedmask Stalker
Collection: Mirebound Court. Swamp creatures serving a drowned marsh court, marked by reeds, lilies, mud, spores, leeches, and deceptive water formations.
Core concept: A camouflaged hunter that reveals itself before firing narrow reed volleys.
Body and silhouette: Lean hunched marsh creature with long arms, thin legs, and a tall bundle of reeds forming its head.
Signature features: Woven reed mask, hooked wooden spear, and dripping moss cape.
Palette and materials: Faded green, wet brown, dark teal, and pale reed yellow.
Movement personality: Patient, stalking, and suddenly decisive.
Attack concept: Freezes and brightens its mask before throwing three reed darts with small, consistent gaps between them.
Directional details: Its spear is carried in the right hand and has one crooked side branch.
Avoid: Human tribal stereotype, invisible camouflage, overly narrow silhouette.
